item.title: It Is Time to Ban the Sale of Precise Geolocation
item.description:
📝 Citizen Lab highlights one Tucson police internal quarterly report that describes how Webloc was used to assist investigators. If data can be used by American law enforcement agencies for their investigations, then that exact same data can be used by foreign intelligence services to target U. item.title: Teddy Roosevelt and Abraham Lincoln in the same photo (2010)
item.description:
📝 Lincoln’s funeral procession passing the Roosevelt Mansion in New York City (Courtesy New York Public Library) History is full of strange coincidences, and the Civil War is no exception. In the 1950s, Stefan Lorant was researching a book on Abraham Lincoln when he came across an image of the President’s funeral procession as it moved down Broadway in New York City. I never did see Lincoln’s funeral.
🔗 Read more: https://prologue.blogs.archives.gov/2010/11/09/teddy-roosevelt-and-abraham-lincoln-in-the-same-photo/
